faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for JNTBGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JNTBGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: 10 Project Fellow, 2 Project Fellow with Ph.D, 2 Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JNTBGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: JNTBGRI, Karimancode P.O, Palode, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on notification date). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.32,560 per month consolidated for Project Fellow, Rs.36,000 per month consolidated for Project Fellow with Ph.D, Rs.30,995 per month consolidated for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project Fellow: First class in M.Sc in the subjects named for each position (Biotech, Botany, Biochemistry or Bioinformatics); Project Fellow with Ph.D: Ph.D Chemistry/Life Sc. or Ph.D Botany; Project Assistant: First class in B.Sc Botany. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reaching after 10 AM will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Written test, if necessary. Written test will be conducted, if necessary. Preference to candidates qualified in National level eligibility test or equivalent.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary Plan Project positions. Appointments are till 31st March 2027 and are likely to be extended. Remuneration is consolidated per month.
